response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate is overqualified for a junior role, lacks demonstrated Java project experience in a professional context, and has only basic German proficiency — a hard requirement for client-facing work in Germany's insurance sector.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong track record in open-source contributions and technical workshops
Proven ability to work in agile environments with CI/CD and TDD practices
concerns: Minimal Java usage in professional roles despite listed skill
German language proficiency is only basic, not sufficient for client collaboration
Senior-level experience makes this a misfit for an entry-level position
